places.name: Training Dojo
places.blurb: Spar with a dummy, and test movesets without risk.

places.name: Gym Replica
places.blurb: Practice against ghost data of opponents who beat you.

places.name: Dream Tower
places.blurb: Spend credits to dream of the road ahead (S109).

places.name: Workshop
places.blurb: Craft balls for credits. Gear tune-ups are in the in-run Camp.

places.name: Daycare
places.blurb: Leave a Pokémon, collect eggs with surprising parentage.

places.name: Pet Corner
places.blurb: Your past Pokémon roam here. Play with them.

places.name: Arcade Corner
places.blurb: Mini versions of battle and rhythm modes, plus darts and Memory Match.

places.name: Basement
places.blurb: A secret door opens when you play the right code of Pokémon cries.

places.name: Rooftop
places.blurb: Watch the weather forecast and choose a lucky charm.

places.name: Elevator
places.blurb: A panel of floor buttons, each showing a mini scene.

places.name: Statue Vault
places.blurb: Turn four statues to face the right way and the vault opens.

places.name: Time Machine
places.blurb: Replay a past run and imagine a different choice.

places.name: Library
places.blurb: Read lore books and take the quiz for rewards.

places.name: Shrine
places.blurb: Offer relics for blessings, and cleanse cursed items.

places.name: Relic Museum
places.blurb: Place found relics on pedestals; matching sets unlock bonuses.

places.name: Trophy Room
places.blurb: Your trophy shelf, and a rubbing minigame to polish them.

places.name: Wall of Fame
places.blurb: Sign the wall with a graffiti stylus.

places.name: Memorial Wall
places.blurb: Nuzlocke losses and aces who fell. Leave a flower.

places.name: Observatory
places.blurb: Stargaze and choose an omen for your next run.

places.name: Radio Tower
places.blurb: Tune a broadcast. Your next run starts with its gift.

places.name: Guestbook
places.blurb: Records past visitors from your friends' ghost data and your own trainers.

places.name: Bulletin Board
places.blurb: Pin contracts and weekly events so you see them first.

places.name: Town Hall
places.blurb: Stats, run history, quests, the season track and the collection book.

places.name: Lost & Found
places.blurb: Items you left behind at the end of runs return here.

places.name: Garden
places.blurb: Water and harvest berries that carry into your next run.

places.name: Berry Orchard
places.blurb: Rows of berry trees that fruit again every day.

places.name: Greenhouse
places.blurb: Raise plants that change as they grow, like Oddish bulbs.

places.name: Kitchen
places.blurb: Prepare run snacks. Combine two ingredients and see what you get.

places.name: Bakery
places.blurb: Baked goods give pre-run buffs. Ding at the right moment.

places.name: Tea Room
places.blurb: Pour tea for a guest and hear a secret.

places.name: Fireplace
places.blurb: Sit with your last team. Each chat is a short vignette.

places.name: Hot Spring
places.blurb: A bond-and-heal session between runs.

places.name: Aquarium
places.blurb: Feed and decorate for Water-type bonds.

places.name: Pond
places.blurb: Skip stones for tiny luck, and fish for the pond log.

places.name: Seasonal Corner
places.blurb: The Hub swaps with the season and gets an interaction prop.

places.name: Night Garden
places.blurb: After dark the Hub fills with fireflies. Catch them for tiny gifts.

places.name: Capsule Corner
places.blurb: A gacha capsule machine for cosmetics. Tap and wiggle the capsule to open it.

places.name: Cinema
places.blurb: Rewatch your best battles and endings.

places.name: Stage
places.blurb: Perform contests to win ribbons.

places.name: Jukebox
places.blurb: Every unlocked track. Tracks unlock with progress.

places.name: Photo Studio
places.blurb: Backdrops and poses for team photos.

places.name: Dressing Mirror
places.blurb: Outfits with a twirl, tailored at the costume shop.

places.name: Meowth Café
places.blurb: Meowth-line staff pay coins for chores. Spend them on treats.

places.name: Furniture Shop
places.blurb: Decorate your room, then drag the pieces anywhere.

places.name: Wishing Tree
places.blurb: Hang tags that give the next run flavor. They never change a roll.

places.name: Hub Phone
places.blurb: Call NPCs for chat and favors.

places.name: Mailbox
places.blurb: Letters from rivals, townsfolk and Pokémon.

places.name: Developer Room
places.blurb: A passage under the bed. The jokes are bad on purpose.

places.name: Town Square
places.blurb: Every building bounces when you step in. The sky mirrors your last run, and pets follow your cursor.

places.name: Training Grounds
places.blurb: Dojo, gym replica, workshop and the places that make you stronger

places.name: Culture Quarter
places.blurb: Library, shrine, museum, trophies and the town memory

places.name: Home Gardens
places.blurb: Gardens, kitchen, hot spring and cosy corners

places.name: Play Street
places.blurb: Capsule machine, cinema, stage and every game

places.name: Hub Town Gate
places.blurb: The road back to Hub Town.
